about: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited, together with its subsidiaries, develops, operates, and maintains port infrastructure in India and internationally. The company is involved in the operation of ports and terminals, including bulk and break bulk, container, liquid, dry bulk, general, LPG/LNG, and crude cargo; terminal and ports related infrastructure development activities; and development of infrastructure at contiguous Special Economic Zone at Mundra.
